description: Checks whether a specific calendar date (or today/tomorrow) is a public holiday, central bank RTGS wire settlement closure, or stock exchange closure in a sovereign country.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, GB, DE, IN, JP, SG).

date.description: Target calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or relative keywords "today" or "tomorrow". Defaults to "today".

name: check_date_status
